title: Every plainly friendly, not-yet-recruited companion (the traveler who becomes Vell, the apprentice who becomes Tamsin, etc.) lists 'attack NPC with belt knife' on the very first turn they are met, with zero prior hostility or provocation shown - tonally odd in a game whose stated thesis is finding 'the words, the bargain, the third way.'
where: The Last Light Inn / 'attack Vell with belt knife' (same pattern at The Forge, Gray Chapel, Hunter's Camp)
